mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_step_record (incident_id, investigation_id, run_no, step_no, status, started_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{s.incidentId}, #{s.investigationId}, #{s.runNo}, #{s.stepNo}, 'RUNNING', #{s.startedAt}, #{s.startedAt}, #{s.startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_id, investigation_id, run_no, step_no, status, started_at FROM agent_step_record WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
